title: Filter Controller type registry and field-source foundation
purpose: Implement the first shared foundation from the robustness audit before per-filter visual polish starts.
entry_condition: PHASE-FC-006 is complete and the synthesis recommends a type registry plus field-source contract as the next implementation slice.
exit_condition: The plugin has a reusable filter type registry, a deterministic field-source contract, backward-compatible preset handling, and validation evidence.
required_outputs: filter type registry in plugin source
field binding resolver in plugin source
normalized field source and resolved key persisted through presets
editor configuration exposes filter type metadata
Toolkit CPT field dynamic tag provider
public Toolkit CPT meta enrichment for filter runtime
acceptance_criteria: Existing saved widgets and presets continue to work.
Manual key, plain field binding, and Elementor dynamic binding keep their existing fallback order.
The new contract stores raw dynamic binding and normalized resolved key without removing legacy fields.
The registry can tell which style/source families each filter type activates.
Toolkit CPT fields can be selected through Elementor dynamic tags without relying on arbitrary manual keys.
Public runtime enrichment only reads Toolkit-managed fields that are intentionally exposed.
No per-filter visual redesign is bundled into this foundation slice.
